title: The Ending That Counts
label: ch:sa-ordinals
canDo: I can make a Sanskrit ordinal from a number by putting -ma on it, and I can name the one number between five and ten where that does not work.

payoff.summary: Complete SA-R62-the-ending and run pañcamaḥ to daśamaḥ, then name the number the chapter walked past and why.
payoff.note: The chapter opens at FIFTH, not at first. -ma is the ending that generalizes -- it makes 5, 7, 8, 9 and 10 with nothing else changing -- and a rule has to be visible before a departure from it can be read as one. Six is deliberately skipped; the next chapter opens on the hole.
